items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: The transcript contains no mention of 'Her brother' by the interviewee Ernie Fields; the text appears to be a transcription error or mismatch where the interviewer or another speaker is discussing a female subject's brother.

ctx.x: Her brother teases her about it and says,--but she's doing real well--he used to say you need somebody to take care of you, but she's doing very well. She was assistant editor the Boston Globe, the third largest newspaper.
